clips.text: 北方有一座被雪埋住的山谷，名叫霜语谷。
clips.spoken: 北方有一座被雪埋住的山谷，名叫霜语谷。
clips.direction: 沉静温暖的女声旁白，句间留白，避免播报腔

clips.text: 十年前，谷心的「永暖圣火」骤然熄灭，从此暴风雪再没有停过。
clips.spoken: 十年前，谷心的永暖圣火骤然熄灭，从此暴风雪再没有停过。
clips.direction: 沉静温暖的女声旁白，句间留白，避免播报腔

clips.text: 我是啾可，住在你祖父风灯里的最后一只霜灵。
clips.spoken: 我是啾可，住在你祖父风灯里的最后一只霜灵。
clips.direction: 明亮灵动的年轻霜灵，亲近但不过分幼态

clips.text: 他说过——雪，总得有人先扫。现在，换你提着这盏灯回家了。
clips.spoken: 他说过——雪，总得有人先扫。现在，换你提着这盏灯回家了。
clips.direction: 明亮灵动的年轻霜灵，亲近但不过分幼态

clips.text: 等等……风灯认得你的手，可我还不知道该怎么称呼你。
clips.spoken: 等等……风灯认得你的手，可我还不知道该怎么称呼你。
clips.direction: 明亮灵动的年轻霜灵，亲近但不过分幼态

clips.text: 告诉我吧。等谷里的灯都亮起来，我要把这个名字告诉每一个回家的人。
clips.spoken: 告诉我吧。等谷里的灯都亮起来，我要把这个名字告诉每一个回家的人。
clips.direction: 明亮灵动的年轻霜灵，亲近但不过分幼态

clips.text: {{playerName}}……好，我记住了。走吧，我们一起把春天找回来。
clips.spoken: 你……好，我记住了。走吧，我们一起把春天找回来。
clips.direction: 明亮灵动的年轻霜灵，亲近但不过分幼态

clips.text: 暴风雪下了整整十年，霜语谷的篝火一盏接一盏熄灭。
clips.spoken: 暴风雪下了整整十年，霜语谷的篝火一盏接一盏熄灭。
clips.direction: 沉静温暖的女声旁白，句间留白，避免播报腔

clips.text: 我提着祖父留下的风灯回到村子。雪很深，可只要肯弯腰，总能扫出第一条路。
clips.spoken: 我提着祖父留下的风灯回到村子。雪很深，可只要肯弯腰，总能扫出第一条路。
clips.direction: 沉静温暖的女声旁白，句间留白，避免播报腔

clips.text: 广场的火堆底下，好像还压着一点没冻死的火星！
clips.spoken: 广场的火堆底下，好像还压着一点没冻死的火星！
clips.direction: 明亮灵动的年轻霜灵，亲近但不过分幼态

clips.text: 孩子，把一堆足够旺的「篝火堆」合出来，再添些金币引火——这村子，就从这儿醒。
clips.spoken: 孩子，把一堆足够旺的篝火堆合出来，再添些金币引火——这村子，就从这儿醒。
clips.direction: 粗粝而慈祥的老猎人，语速舒缓

clips.text: 还有一点火星！别让它被风抢走——再靠近一点。
clips.spoken: 还有一点火星！别让它被风抢走——再靠近一点。
clips.direction: 明亮灵动的年轻霜灵，亲近但不过分幼态

clips.text: 十年了……手指头总算又有了知觉。我叫冈特，是这村里最后一个没走的老猎人。
clips.spoken: 十年了……手指头总算又有了知觉。我叫冈特，是这村里最后一个没走的老猎人。
clips.direction: 粗粝而慈祥的老猎人，语速舒缓

clips.text: {{playerName}}，你提的这盏风灯，是埃文的吧。他是你祖父，也是谷里最好的霜灵师。
clips.spoken: 你提的这盏风灯，是埃文的吧。他是你祖父，也是谷里最好的霜灵师。
clips.direction: 粗粝而慈祥的老猎人，语速舒缓

clips.text: 你听，屋里有人推开窗了。第一堆火不是景色——是他们终于敢相信，我们回来了。
clips.spoken: 你听，屋里有人推开窗了。第一堆火不是景色——是他们终于敢相信，我们回来了。
clips.direction: 明亮灵动的年轻霜灵，亲近但不过分幼态

clips.text: 我这屋顶漏雪漏了三年，夜里雪落在被上，早上得从雪堆里把自己刨出来。
clips.spoken: 我这屋顶漏雪漏了三年，夜里雪落在被上，早上得从雪堆里把自己刨出来。
clips.direction: 粗粝而慈祥的老猎人，语速舒缓

clips.text: 合两块结实的木板，再凑点工钱，让我这把老骨头，也睡个不漏雪的觉吧。
clips.spoken: 合两块结实的木板，再凑点工钱，让我这把老骨头，也睡个不漏雪的觉吧。
clips.direction: 粗粝而慈祥的老猎人，语速舒缓

clips.text: 木板一钉，风雪被挡在门外，屋里静得能听见炭火爆开的声音。
clips.spoken: 木板一钉，风雪被挡在门外，屋里静得能听见炭火爆开的声音。
clips.direction: 粗粝而慈祥的老猎人，语速舒缓

clips.text: 冈特爷爷，你刚才说我祖父……他十年前到底去了哪里？
clips.spoken: 冈特爷爷，你刚才说我祖父……他十年前到底去了哪里？
clips.direction: 明亮灵动的年轻霜灵，亲近但不过分幼态

clips.text: 埃文他……最后去了山巅。等你把这村子焐得再暖些，我慢慢讲给你听。
clips.spoken: 埃文他……最后去了山巅。等你把这村子焐得再暖些，我慢慢讲给你听。
clips.direction: 粗粝而慈祥的老猎人，语速舒缓

clips.text: 好。那我就先让每一间屋子，都不再漏雪。
clips.spoken: 好。那我就先让每一间屋子，都不再漏雪。
clips.direction: 明亮灵动的年轻霜灵，亲近但不过分幼态

clips.text: 请、请问——桥那头还有人吗？我是邮差波波，驮着一袋子十年没送出去的信！
clips.spoken: 请、请问——桥那头还有人吗？我是邮差波波，驮着一袋子十年没送出去的信！
clips.direction: 年轻热心的企鹅邮差，略带急促

clips.text: 可桥断了，我又不敢踩冰。能架上木梁、点支火把照路吗？大家都等着外面的消息呢。
clips.spoken: 可桥断了，我又不敢踩冰。能架上木梁、点支火把照路吗？大家都等着外面的消息呢。
clips.direction: 年轻热心的企鹅邮差，略带急促

clips.text: 信、信件能送进村了！你看这封——是从山那边寄来的，收信人写着「还留在霜语谷的人」。
clips.spoken: 信、信件能送进村了！你看这封——是从山那边寄来的，收信人写着还留在霜语谷的人。
clips.direction: 年轻热心的企鹅邮差，略带急促

clips.text: 外面的世界，还没忘记我们啊。
clips.spoken: 外面的世界，还没忘记我们啊。
clips.direction: 粗粝而慈祥的老猎人，语速舒缓

clips.text: 桥通了，街坊们也该一个一个回来了。艾莎奶奶托我送来毛线篮，先给赶路的人织一双暖手套。
clips.spoken: 桥通了，街坊们也该一个一个回来了。艾莎奶奶托我送来毛线篮，先给赶路的人织一双暖手套。
clips.direction: 明亮灵动的年轻霜灵，亲近但不过分幼态

clips.text: 太好啦！我这就去把信，送到山谷每一个角落！
clips.spoken: 太好啦！我这就去把信，送到山谷每一个角落！
clips.direction: 年轻热心的企鹅邮差，略带急促

clips.text: 今晚把大家都叫到村厅来吧。十年了，没人敢在夜里聚一聚——都怕聚完，人又少几个。
clips.spoken: 今晚把大家都叫到村厅来吧。十年了，没人敢在夜里聚一聚——都怕聚完，人又少几个。
clips.direction: 粗粝而慈祥的老猎人，语速舒缓

clips.text: 那我们就织几副手套、煮几壶热茶，把这一夜过得暖暖和和的，让大家敢留下来。
clips.spoken: 那我们就织几副手套、煮几壶热茶，把这一夜过得暖暖和和的，让大家敢留下来。
clips.direction: 明亮灵动的年轻霜灵，亲近但不过分幼态

clips.text: 你把「{{choice}}」挂上房梁。炉火噼啪，热茶冒着白汽，村厅里第一次有了说笑声。
clips.spoken: 你把选好的主灯挂上房梁。炉火噼啪，热茶冒着白汽，村厅里第一次有了说笑声。
clips.direction: 沉静温暖的女声旁白，句间留白，避免播报腔

clips.text: 埃文临走那晚，也是这样一炉火。他说圣火不是被风吹灭的，是被人一点点遗忘、没人再添柴，才冷下去的。
clips.spoken: 埃文临走那晚，也是这样一炉火。他说圣火不是被风吹灭的，是被人一点点遗忘、没人再添柴，才冷下去的。
clips.direction: 粗粝而慈祥的老猎人，语速舒缓

clips.text: 他上山前把这盏风灯交给我，说『等下一个肯扫雪的人回来，就替我还给它』。
clips.spoken: 他上山前把这盏风灯交给我，说等下一个肯扫雪的人回来，就替我还给它。
clips.direction: 粗粝而慈祥的老猎人，语速舒缓

clips.text: 原来我被留下来，是为了等你呀，{{playerName}}。
clips.spoken: 原来我被留下来，是为了等你呀。
clips.direction: 明亮灵动的年轻霜灵，亲近但不过分幼态

clips.text: 村子醒了，可光有我们还不够——木桥那头，还有整条沉在雪里的街。
clips.spoken: 村子醒了，可光有我们还不够——木桥那头，还有整条沉在雪里的街。
clips.direction: 明亮灵动的年轻霜灵，亲近但不过分幼态

clips.text: 我把面包坊的旧烤箱推来了。下一盏灯亮起时，让香味也跟着过桥吧。
clips.spoken: 我把面包坊的旧烤箱推来了。下一盏灯亮起时，让香味也跟着过桥吧。
clips.direction: 爽朗温暖的面包师，带笑意

clips.text: 木桥那头，面包坊、裁缝铺和旧码头都还沉在雪里，招牌被雪压得抬不起头。
clips.spoken: 木桥那头，面包坊、裁缝铺和旧码头都还沉在雪里，招牌被雪压得抬不起头。
clips.direction: 沉静温暖的女声旁白，句间留白，避免播报腔

clips.text: 把炉火点进每一间铺子，让这条街重新冒出热气、飘出香味。
clips.spoken: 把炉火点进每一间铺子，让这条街重新冒出热气、飘出香味。
clips.direction: 沉静温暖的女声旁白，句间留白，避免播报腔

clips.text: 呀，是活人的脚步声！我是蜜儿，面包师。我的烤箱冻得打不开，配方本也冻成了冰砖……
clips.spoken: 呀，是活人的脚步声！我是蜜儿，面包师。我的烤箱冻得打不开，配方本也冻成了冰砖……
clips.direction: 爽朗温暖的面包师，带笑意

clips.text: 帮我烤一张麦饼、沏一杯热茶，让烤箱先暖起来好不好？香味一出来，街坊就知道家还在了。
clips.spoken: 帮我烤一张麦饼、沏一杯热茶，让烤箱先暖起来好不好？香味一出来，街坊就知道家还在了。
clips.direction: 爽朗温暖的面包师，带笑意

clips.text: 烤箱一热，麦饼的香味能飘到山脚！你闻——第一炉只是开始，浆果派很快也会回来。
clips.spoken: 烤箱一热，麦饼的香味能飘到山脚！你闻——第一炉只是开始，浆果派很快也会回来。
clips.direction: 爽朗温暖的面包师，带笑意

clips.text: 这就是山谷醒来的味道呀。蜜儿姐，灾变那年你怎么没走？
clips.spoken: 这就是山谷醒来的味道呀。蜜儿姐，灾变那年你怎么没走？
clips.direction: 明亮灵动的年轻霜灵，亲近但不过分幼态

clips.text: 我答应过妹妹，要守着店，等她回来吃我烤的第一个派。
clips.spoken: 我答应过妹妹，要守着店，等她回来吃我烤的第一个派。
clips.direction: 爽朗温暖的面包师，带笑意

clips.text: 第一个派，一定给你，{{playerName}}。谢谢你，让我又能开始等一个人了。
clips.spoken: 第一个派，一定给你。谢谢你，让我又能开始等一个人了。
clips.direction: 爽朗温暖的面包师，带笑意

clips.text: 哎哟，我的老花镜都冻在桌上喽。来，孩子，帮奶奶赶一顶毛线帽，再备一条围巾。
clips.spoken: 哎哟，我的老花镜都冻在桌上喽。来，孩子，帮奶奶赶一顶毛线帽，再备一条围巾。
clips.direction: 慈爱的年长裁缝，柔和从容

clips.text: 我要织得松松软软，围巾一人一条——这山谷里，再不许有人冻着。
clips.spoken: 我要织得松松软软，围巾一人一条——这山谷里，再不许有人冻着。
clips.direction: 慈爱的年长裁缝，柔和从容

clips.text: 帽子要织得松松软软，围巾一人一条，谁都不许再冻着。
clips.spoken: 帽子要织得松松软软，围巾一人一条，谁都不许再冻着。
clips.direction: 慈爱的年长裁缝，柔和从容

clips.text: 艾莎奶奶的针线，比炉火还暖呢。
clips.spoken: 艾莎奶奶的针线，比炉火还暖呢。
clips.direction: 明亮灵动的年轻霜灵，亲近但不过分幼态

clips.text: 老啦，手指不听使唤，可一想到有人正冷着，就还能再织一针。
clips.spoken: 老啦，手指不听使唤，可一想到有人正冷着，就还能再织一针。
clips.direction: 慈爱的年长裁缝，柔和从容

clips.text: 你和你祖父一个样，手巧，心也热。
clips.spoken: 你和你祖父一个样，手巧，心也热。
clips.direction: 慈爱的年长裁缝，柔和从容

clips.text: 码头冻住啦，渔船出不去，外面的人也回不来！
clips.spoken: 码头冻住啦，渔船出不去，外面的人也回不来！
clips.direction: 年轻热心的企鹅邮差，略带急促

clips.text: 换上结实的门窗框，再给破冰的船工备足热茶。冰一破开，这条路就活了。
clips.spoken: 换上结实的门窗框，再给破冰的船工备足热茶。冰一破开，这条路就活了。
clips.direction: 粗粝而慈祥的老猎人，语速舒缓

clips.text: 码头修好啦，渔船可以出湖，热茶给船工们备好！
clips.spoken: 码头修好啦，渔船可以出湖，热茶给船工们备好！
clips.direction: 年轻热心的企鹅邮差，略带急促

clips.text: 听，是凿冰的声音。这条街，又活过来喽。
clips.spoken: 听，是凿冰的声音。这条街，又活过来喽。
clips.direction: 粗粝而慈祥的老猎人，语速舒缓

clips.text: 船工们把一箱没用完的补给留给你了，风灯里又攒下十次余温。趁热把下一批材料合出来吧。
clips.spoken: 船工们把一箱没用完的补给留给你了，风灯里又攒下十次余温。趁热把下一批材料合出来吧。
clips.direction: 明亮灵动的年轻霜灵，亲近但不过分幼态

clips.text: 等第一艘船靠岸，我要烤满满一窗台的派！
clips.spoken: 等第一艘船靠岸，我要烤满满一窗台的派！
clips.direction: 爽朗温暖的面包师，带笑意

clips.text: 码头通了，今晚办一场灯宴吧！让十年没聚过的街坊，痛痛快快热闹一回。
clips.spoken: 码头通了，今晚办一场灯宴吧！让十年没聚过的街坊，痛痛快快热闹一回。
clips.direction: 爽朗温暖的面包师，带笑意

clips.text: 我给每个人缝一顶新帽子。孩子，蛋糕和热饮就拜托你啦。
clips.spoken: 我给每个人缝一顶新帽子。孩子，蛋糕和热饮就拜托你啦。
clips.direction: 慈爱的年长裁缝，柔和从容

clips.text: 一盏盏风灯挂上街檐，浆果派切开，热可可甜得发暖，新帽子在灯下毛茸茸的。
clips.spoken: 一盏盏风灯挂上街檐，浆果派切开，热可可甜得发暖，新帽子在灯下毛茸茸的。
clips.direction: 沉静温暖的女声旁白，句间留白，避免播报腔

clips.text: 报告大家一个好消息——我收到山那边的回信了！信上说，南迁的人，一直在等山谷重新亮起灯。
clips.spoken: 报告大家一个好消息——我收到山那边的回信了！信上说，南迁的人，一直在等山谷重新亮起灯。
clips.direction: 年轻热心的企鹅邮差，略带急促

clips.text: 灯一亮，他们就认得回家的路了。
clips.spoken: 灯一亮，他们就认得回家的路了。
clips.direction: 粗粝而慈祥的老猎人，语速舒缓

clips.text: 可山谷最高处的圣殿还是黑的。那里，是十年前最后熄灭的地方。

clips.text: In the north lies a snow-buried valley called Frostwhisper Valley.
clips.spoken: In the north lies a snow-buried valley called Frostwhisper Valley.

clips.text: Ten years ago, the Everwarm Flame at the heart of the valley suddenly went out, and the blizzard never stopped.
clips.spoken: Ten years ago, the Everwarm Flame at the heart of the valley suddenly went out, and the blizzard never stopped.

clips.text: I'm Choco, the last frost spirit living in your grandfather's wind lantern.
clips.spoken: I'm Choco, the last frost spirit living in your grandfather's wind lantern.

clips.text: He used to say—someone always has to clear the first patch of snow. Now it's your turn to carry this wind lantern home.
clips.spoken: He used to say—someone always has to clear the first patch of snow. Now it's your turn to carry this wind lantern home.

clips.text: Wait... the wind lantern recognizes your hand, but I still don't know what to call you.
clips.spoken: Wait... the wind lantern recognizes your hand, but I still don't know what to call you.

clips.text: Tell me. When all the lights in the valley are lit, I'll share your name with everyone coming home.
clips.spoken: Tell me. When all the lights in the valley are lit, I'll share your name with everyone coming home.

clips.text: {{playerName}}... Okay, I've got it. Let's go find spring together.
clips.spoken: You... Okay, I've got it. Let's go find spring together.

clips.text: The blizzard raged for ten years as the campfires of Frostwhisper Valley faded one by one.
clips.spoken: The blizzard raged for ten years as the campfires of Frostwhisper Valley faded one by one.

clips.text: I carried my grandfather's wind lantern back to the village. The snow was deep, but if you're willing to bend down, you can always clear a path.
clips.spoken: I carried my grandfather's wind lantern back to the village. The snow was deep, but if you're willing to bend down, you can always clear a path.

clips.text: There may still be a spark alive beneath the fire pit in the plaza!
clips.spoken: There may still be a spark alive beneath the fire pit in the plaza!

clips.text: Child, merge a roaring Bonfire, then spend a few Coins to get it going—this is where the village wakes.
clips.spoken: Child, merge a roaring Bonfire, then spend a few Coins to get it going—this is where the village wakes.

clips.text: There's still a spark! Don't let the wind take it—just a bit closer.
clips.spoken: There's still a spark! Don't let the wind take it—just a bit closer.

clips.text: Ten years... I can finally feel my fingers again. I'm Gunnar, the last old hunter who never left this village.
clips.spoken: Ten years... I can finally feel my fingers again. I'm Gunnar, the last old hunter who never left this village.

clips.text: {{playerName}}, you're carrying Evan's wind lantern, aren't you? He was your grandfather and the valley's finest frostweaver.
clips.spoken: You're carrying Evan's wind lantern, aren't you? He was your grandfather and the valley's finest frostweaver.

clips.text: Listen—someone just opened a window. That first fire isn't a pretty sight. It's proof they finally dare to believe we've come back.
clips.spoken: Listen—someone just opened a window. That first fire isn't a pretty sight. It's proof they finally dare to believe we've come back.

clips.text: My roof has been leaking snow for three years. At night, it falls on my bedding; in the morning, I have to dig myself out from under the snow.
clips.spoken: My roof has been leaking snow for three years. At night, it falls on my bedding; in the morning, I have to dig myself out from under the snow.

clips.text: Merge two sturdy Wood Planks and set aside a little pay, so these old bones can sleep one night without snow falling in.
clips.spoken: Merge two sturdy Wood Planks and set aside a little pay, so these old bones can sleep one night without snow falling in.

clips.text: With the boards nailed down, the wind is blocked. The house is so quiet you can hear the charcoal crackle.
clips.spoken: With the boards nailed down, the wind is blocked. The house is so quiet you can hear the charcoal crackle.

clips.text: Grandpa Gunnar, you mentioned my grandfather... where did he go ten years ago?
clips.spoken: Grandpa Gunnar, you mentioned my grandfather... where did he go ten years ago?

clips.text: Evan... he went to the mountain peak. Once you make this village a bit warmer, I'll tell you the story.
clips.spoken: Evan... he went to the mountain peak. Once you make this village a bit warmer, I'll tell you the story.

clips.text: Alright. Then I'll start by making sure no house lets in any snow.
clips.spoken: Alright. Then I'll start by making sure no house lets in any snow.

clips.text: Ex-excuse me—is anyone on the other side of the bridge? I'm Bobo the courier, carrying a bag of letters undelivered for ten years!
clips.spoken: Ex-excuse me—is anyone on the other side of the bridge? I'm Bobo the courier, carrying a bag of letters undelivered for ten years!

clips.text: But the bridge is broken, and I'm too scared to trust the ice. Could you lay a Wooden Beam and light a Torch to show the way? Everyone is waiting for news from outside.
clips.spoken: But the bridge is broken, and I'm too scared to trust the ice. Could you lay a Wooden Beam and light a Torch to show the way? Everyone is waiting for news from outside.

clips.text: L-the letters can reach the village now! Look at this one—it came from beyond the mountain, addressed to "Those Still in Frostwhisper Valley."
clips.spoken: L-the letters can reach the village now! Look at this one—it came from beyond the mountain, addressed to "Those Still in Frostwhisper Valley."

clips.text: The world outside hasn't forgotten us yet.
clips.spoken: The world outside hasn't forgotten us yet.

clips.text: The bridge is open; it's time for the neighbors to come home one by one. Grandma Elsa asked me to bring a basket of yarn to knit warm gloves for those on the road.
clips.spoken: The bridge is open; it's time for the neighbors to come home one by one. Grandma Elsa asked me to bring a basket of yarn to knit warm gloves for those on the road.

clips.text: That's great! I'll deliver these letters to every corner of the valley right now!
clips.spoken: That's great! I'll deliver these letters to every corner of the valley right now!

clips.text: Gather everyone at the town hall tonight. For ten years, no one dared gather at night—everyone was afraid there'd be fewer people left after.
clips.spoken: Gather everyone at the town hall tonight. For ten years, no one dared gather at night—everyone was afraid there'd be fewer people left after.

clips.text: Then we'll knit some gloves and brew pots of hot tea to keep everyone warm tonight, so they feel safe staying.
clips.spoken: Then we'll knit some gloves and brew pots of hot tea to keep everyone warm tonight, so they feel safe staying.

clips.text: You hang the "{{choice}}" from the rafters. With crackling fire and steaming tea, laughter fills the town hall for the first time.
clips.spoken: You hang your chosen main lamp from the rafters. With crackling fire and steaming tea, laughter fills the town hall for the first time.

clips.text: On the night Evan left, there was a fire just like this. He said the Sacred Flame wasn't blown out by the wind; it grew cold because people forgot it and stopped adding wood.
clips.spoken: On the night Evan left, there was a fire just like this. He said the Sacred Flame wasn't blown out by the wind; it grew cold because people forgot it and stopped adding wood.

clips.text: Before he climbed the mountain, he gave me this wind lantern and said, "When the next person willing to clear the snow comes home, return it to them for me."
clips.spoken: Before he climbed the mountain, he gave me this wind lantern and said, "When the next person willing to clear the snow comes home, return it to them for me."

clips.text: So I was left behind just to wait for you, {{playerName}}.
clips.spoken: So I was left behind just to wait for you.

clips.text: The village is waking up, but we need more than just ourselves—there's the other side of the bridge, and the entire street buried in snow.
clips.spoken: The village is waking up, but we need more than just ourselves—there's the other side of the bridge, and the entire street buried in snow.

clips.text: I've rolled over the old oven from the bakery. When the next light flickers on, let the aroma cross the bridge too.
clips.spoken: I've rolled over the old oven from the bakery. When the next light flickers on, let the aroma cross the bridge too.

clips.text: Beyond the wooden bridge, the bakery, tailor shop, and old pier lie buried in snow, their signs weighed down by the frost.
clips.spoken: Beyond the wooden bridge, the bakery, tailor shop, and old pier lie buried in snow, their signs weighed down by the frost.

clips.text: Light a fire in every shop. Let this street breathe again, filled with warmth and aroma.
clips.spoken: Light a fire in every shop. Let this street breathe again, filled with warmth and aroma.

clips.text: Oh! I hear footsteps of a living soul! I'm Mier, the baker. My oven is frozen shut, and my recipe book is a block of ice...
clips.spoken: Oh! I hear footsteps of a living soul! I'm Mier, the baker. My oven is frozen shut, and my recipe book is a block of ice...

clips.text: Help me bake a flatbread and brew some hot tea to warm up the oven first, okay? Once the scent drifts out, the neighbors will know home is still here.
clips.spoken: Help me bake a flatbread and brew some hot tea to warm up the oven first, okay? Once the scent drifts out, the neighbors will know home is still here.

clips.text: Once the oven warms up, the smell of flatbread will reach the foot of the mountain! Just wait—the first batch is only the beginning; berry pies are coming soon too.
clips.spoken: Once the oven warms up, the smell of flatbread will reach the foot of the mountain! Just wait—the first batch is only the beginning; berry pies are coming soon too.

clips.text: That's the scent of the valley waking up. Mier, why didn't you leave during the Cataclysm?
clips.spoken: That's the scent of the valley waking up. Mier, why didn't you leave during the Cataclysm?

clips.text: I promised my sister I'd keep the shop open until she came home for the first pie from my oven.
clips.spoken: I promised my sister I'd keep the shop open until she came home for the first pie from my oven.

clips.text: The first pie is yours, {{playerName}}. Thank you for letting me believe I can wait for someone again.
clips.spoken: The first pie is yours. Thank you for letting me believe I can wait for someone again.

clips.text: Oh my, my spectacles are frozen to the table! Come here, child, help Grandma knit a wool cap and a scarf.
clips.spoken: Oh my, my spectacles are frozen to the table! Come here, child, help Grandma knit a wool cap and a scarf.

clips.text: I'll make them soft and cozy. One scarf for each person—no one in this valley should be left shivering anymore.
clips.spoken: I'll make them soft and cozy. One scarf for each person—no one in this valley should be left shivering anymore.

clips.text: Every hat should be soft and cozy, with a scarf for each person. No one gets left in the cold.
clips.spoken: Every hat should be soft and cozy, with a scarf for each person. No one gets left in the cold.

clips.text: Grandma Elsa's knitting feels warmer than a hearth fire.
clips.spoken: Grandma Elsa's knitting feels warmer than a hearth fire.

clips.text: I'm old, and my fingers don't always obey, but when I think of someone out in the cold, I can manage one more stitch.
clips.spoken: I'm old, and my fingers don't always obey, but when I think of someone out in the cold, I can manage one more stitch.

clips.text: You're just like your grandfather—skilled hands and a warm heart.
clips.spoken: You're just like your grandfather—skilled hands and a warm heart.

clips.text: The pier is frozen! The fishing boats can't get out, and no one from the outside can get in!
clips.spoken: The pier is frozen! The fishing boats can't get out, and no one from the outside can get in!

clips.text: Fit sturdy Door & Window Frames, then brew plenty of Hot Tea for the icebreakers. Once the ice gives way, this route will live again.
clips.spoken: Fit sturdy Door & Window Frames, then brew plenty of Hot Tea for the icebreakers. Once the ice gives way, this route will live again.

clips.text: The pier is fixed! The boats can head out to the lake, and the tea is ready for the crew!
clips.spoken: The pier is fixed! The boats can head out to the lake, and the tea is ready for the crew!

clips.text: Listen... that's the sound of ice being broken. This street is coming back to life.
clips.spoken: Listen... that's the sound of ice being broken. This street is coming back to life.

clips.text: The sailors left a crate of supplies for you, and your wind lanterns have enough warmth for ten more uses. Use them to merge the next batch of materials while they're hot.
clips.spoken: The sailors left a crate of supplies for you, and your wind lanterns have enough warmth for ten more uses. Use them to merge the next batch of materials while they're hot.

clips.text: Once the first ship docks, I'm baking a whole windowsill full of pies!
clips.spoken: Once the first ship docks, I'm baking a whole windowsill full of pies!

clips.text: The pier is open! Let's have a lantern feast tonight. It's time for the neighbors who haven't met in ten years to celebrate together.
clips.spoken: The pier is open! Let's have a lantern feast tonight. It's time for the neighbors who haven't met in ten years to celebrate together.

clips.text: I'll knit new hats for everyone. Child, I'm counting on you for the cakes and hot drinks.
clips.spoken: I'll knit new hats for everyone. Child, I'm counting on you for the cakes and hot drinks.

clips.text: Wind lanterns line the eaves. Berry Pies are sliced and shared, Hot Cocoa warms everyone from within, and new hats glow soft and fuzzy in the light.
clips.spoken: Wind lanterns line the eaves. Berry Pies are sliced and shared, Hot Cocoa warms everyone from within, and new hats glow soft and fuzzy in the light.

clips.text: I have good news for everyone—I received a reply from across the mountains! They said those who migrated south have been waiting for the valley's lights to shine again.
clips.spoken: I have good news for everyone—I received a reply from across the mountains! They said those who migrated south have been waiting for the valley's lights to shine again.

clips.text: Once the lights are on, they'll find their way home.
clips.spoken: Once the lights are on, they'll find their way home.

clips.text: But the sanctuary at the highest peak is still dark. That was the place where the last light went out ten years ago.
clips.spoken: But the sanctuary at the highest peak is still dark. That was the place where the last light went out ten years ago.

clips.text: It's time. Let's climb the mountain and face the flame no one has dared touch in ten years.
clips.spoken: It's time. Let's climb the mountain and face the flame no one has dared touch in ten years.

clips.text: At the highest peak lies the Everwarm Sanctuary. Its white stone has been weathered into pale blue by wind and snow; its gates have remained shut for ten years.
clips.spoken: At the highest peak lies the Everwarm Sanctuary. Its white stone has been weathered into pale blue by wind and snow; its gates have remained shut for ten years.

clips.text: Legend says if the sacred fire is rekindled, no blizzard can ever swallow this land again. But when we pushed open that door, we realized—the story was only just beginning.
clips.spoken: Legend says if the sacred fire is rekindled, no blizzard can ever swallow this land again. But when we pushed open that door, we realized—the story was only just beginning.

clips.text: Finally, someone's here. I'm Barr, the blacksmith. For ten years, I've been guarding this broken door.
clips.spoken: Finally, someone's here. I'm Barr, the blacksmith. For ten years, I've been guarding this broken door.

clips.text: I've reinforced the stone walls. All we need is a Warm Stove and some sturdy Door & Window Frames. Make the hall livable first; we'll build the true Fireplace once everyone returns.
clips.spoken: I've reinforced the stone walls. All we need is a Warm Stove and some sturdy Door & Window Frames. Make the hall livable first; we'll build the true Fireplace once everyone returns.

clips.text: Once this Warm Stove is burning, even the stones can breathe easy. When everyone returns, we'll rebuild it into a Fireplace that lasts a hundred years.
clips.spoken: Once this Warm Stove is burning, even the stones can breathe easy. When everyone returns, we'll rebuild it into a Fireplace that lasts a hundred years.

clips.text: The hall is warm now; everyone has a place to gather. Uncle Barr, have you been guarding this alone for ten years?
clips.spoken: The hall is warm now; everyone has a place to gather. Uncle Barr, have you been guarding this alone for ten years?

clips.text: ...I promised someone I wouldn't let this place collapse. Let's work first; we can talk about the past later.
clips.spoken: ...I promised someone I wouldn't let this place collapse. Let's work first; we can talk about the past later.

clips.text: A large crack in the dome lets snow and wind pour in. We need to set a crystal crown to catch the light and hang curtains of knitted wool to block the wind.
clips.spoken: A large crack in the dome lets snow and wind pour in. We need to set a crystal crown to catch the light and hang curtains of knitted wool to block the wind.

clips.text: Let the light flood the hall again, as if we're bringing the stars back onto the roof.
clips.spoken: Let the light flood the hall again, as if we're bringing the stars back onto the roof.

clips.text: When the frost crystals are set in the dome, they'll scatter light like a field of stars.
clips.spoken: When the frost crystals are set in the dome, they'll scatter light like a field of stars.

clips.text: Once we hang the thick wool curtains, the wind won't be able to get in anymore.
clips.spoken: Once we hang the thick wool curtains, the wind won't be able to get in anymore.

clips.text: The moment the frost crystals lit up, the hall was bathed in a pale blue haze, like the starry sky of ten years ago falling back to earth.
clips.spoken: The moment the frost crystals lit up, the hall was bathed in a pale blue haze, like the starry sky of ten years ago falling back to earth.

clips.text: ...It's just like it was that year. Only one step left.
clips.spoken: ...It's just like it was that year. Only one step left.

clips.text: A Warm Stove, Honey Brew, a Furniture Set... we don't need the rarest offerings in the world. {{playerName}}, a Flamekeeper brings every bit of warmth within reach.
clips.spoken: A Warm Stove, Honey Brew, a Furniture Set... we don't need the rarest offerings in the world. A Flamekeeper brings every bit of warmth within reach.

clips.text: I've stood here with my lantern for ten years, waiting for this moment. Come, let us return the fire to where it belongs.
clips.spoken: I've stood here with my lantern for ten years, waiting for this moment. Come, let us return the fire to where it belongs.

clips.text: The Warm Stove's flame touched the heart of the altar—whoosh! A pillar of gold surged upward, and the Frostwood Furniture chimed like wind bells in the heat.
clips.spoken: The Warm Stove's flame touched the heart of the altar—whoosh! A pillar of gold surged upward, and the Frostwood Furniture chimed like wind bells in the heat.

clips.text: Everwarm Flame... please, never go out again.
clips.spoken: Everwarm Flame... please, never go out again.

clips.text: Look—the snowfall is easing!
clips.spoken: Look—the snowfall is easing!

clips.text: But the light rose only halfway before casting a moving image across the dome: at the eye of the mountaintop storm lay a huge blue heart, beating faintly.
clips.spoken: But the light rose only halfway before casting a moving image across the dome: at the eye of the mountaintop storm lay a huge blue heart, beating faintly.

clips.text: Just as I thought... the Sacred Flame is only the key. Whatever truly froze the valley is up there.
clips.spoken: Just as I thought... the Sacred Flame is only the key. Whatever truly froze the valley is up there.

clips.text: That's... the Frostheart. It's still alive, it's just forgotten how to beat.
clips.spoken: That's... the Frostheart. It's still alive, it's just forgotten how to beat.

clips.text: The sacred fire cast ancient murals onto the walls, though some words were covered by frost. Using the crystals to catch the light, let's read them together.
clips.spoken: The sacred fire cast ancient murals onto the walls, though some words were covered by frost. Using the crystals to catch the light, let's read them together.

clips.text: Evan surely read these back then.
clips.spoken: Evan surely read these back then.

clips.text: As the ice pillars, bonfires, and woolens fell into place, lines of ancient frost-script began to glow on the mural.
clips.spoken: As the ice pillars, bonfires, and woolens fell into place, lines of ancient frost-script began to glow on the mural.

clips.text: "The Long Snow began when the Frostheart slept. To call spring home, seek four kinds of human warmth—"
clips.spoken: "The Long Snow began when the Frostheart slept. To call spring home, seek four kinds of human warmth—"

clips.text: "The hope of a bonfire. The bond between neighbors. The courage to let go. The wish to pass on the light. When all four warmths unite, the Frostheart shall wake."
clips.spoken: "The hope of a bonfire. The bond between neighbors. The courage to let go. The wish to pass on the light. When all four warmths unite, the Frostheart shall wake."

clips.text: We have the hope of the bonfire. The other three lie in the outer port, across the snows, and within our own hearts.
clips.spoken: We have the hope of the bonfire. The other three lie in the outer port, across the snows, and within our own hearts.

clips.text: Let's go to Homewing Harbor first. The bridge and pier are open; it's time to bring the scattered families home.
clips.spoken: Let's go to Homewing Harbor first. The bridge and pier are open; it's time to bring the scattered families home.

clips.text: Beyond the thawing river lies Frostwhisper Valley's old gateway to the world—Homewing Harbor.
clips.spoken: Beyond the thawing river lies Frostwhisper Valley's old gateway to the world—Homewing Harbor.

clips.text: The port was sealed for ten years; the lighthouse went dark, and the ferries were frozen in ice. To bring the lost ones home, we must first light their way back.
clips.spoken: The port was sealed for ten years; the lighthouse went dark, and the ferries were frozen in ice. To bring the lost ones home, we must first light their way back.

clips.text: The lighthouse hasn't shone for a decade! Ships returning home can't find the shore at all!
clips.spoken: The lighthouse hasn't shone for a decade! Ships returning home can't find the shore at all!

clips.text: We'll build the tower with cabin parts and top it with a constant hearth. Let its light be the first to say "Welcome home" for the valley.
clips.spoken: We'll build the tower with cabin parts and top it with a constant hearth. Let its light be the first to say "Welcome home" for the valley.

clips.text: The lighthouse flared back to life, its beam sweeping across the gray sea like an arm slowly opening wide.
clips.spoken: The lighthouse flared back to life, its beam sweeping across the gray sea like an arm slowly opening wide.

clips.text: It's lit! It's lit! Ships miles away can see that light now!
clips.spoken: It's lit! It's lit! Ships miles away can see that light now!

clips.text: Years ago, when Evan saw the villagers off at the port, he stood under this very tower and said, "As long as the light shines, you can always come home."
clips.spoken: Years ago, when Evan saw the villagers off at the port, he stood under this very tower and said, "As long as the light shines, you can always come home."

clips.text: The hulls are cracked, and the boilers have gone cold. Without a ship, no matter how bright the light is, no one can cross this sea.
clips.spoken: The hulls are cracked, and the boilers have gone cold. Without a ship, no matter how bright the light is, no one can cross this sea.

clips.text: We must stock enough honeyed drinks in the cabins. The road home is cold; everyone needs to have warm hands when they step off the boat.
clips.spoken: We must stock enough honeyed drinks in the cabins. The road home is cold; everyone needs to have warm hands when they step off the boat.

clips.text: As the new planks were fitted and the boiler roared back to life, the ferry exhaled its first breath of white steam in ten years.
clips.spoken: As the new planks were fitted and the boiler roared back to life, the ferry exhaled its first breath of white steam in ten years.

clips.text: Woo-hoo! She's sounding again—the Warm Current can sail!
clips.spoken: Woo-hoo! She's sounding again—the Warm Current can sail!

clips.text: We have a ship, we have light, and we have warm drinks. Now, all we need is a reason for people to want to come home.
clips.spoken: We have a ship, we have light, and we have warm drinks. Now, all we need is a reason for people to want to come home.

clips.text: People coming home need a place to stay, a hot meal, and clean clothes. Let's get the market set up first!
clips.spoken: People coming home need a place to stay, a hot meal, and clean clothes. Let's get the market set up first!

clips.text: Let's hang some Frost Crystals. When it looks warm from afar, people will finally believe this isn't a dream.
clips.spoken: Let's hang some Frost Crystals. When it looks warm from afar, people will finally believe this isn't a dream.

clips.text: The sweet scent of ginger bread, heavy down coats, and glowing Frost Crystals gave the empty pier the silhouette of a home.
clips.spoken: The sweet scent of ginger bread, heavy down coats, and glowing Frost Crystals gave the empty pier the silhouette of a home.

clips.text: Report! The first homecoming boat has docked—it's a family of three. They said they burst into tears when they saw the lighthouse.
clips.spoken: Report! The first homecoming boat has docked—it's a family of three. They said they burst into tears when they saw the lighthouse.

clips.text: Welcome, welcome! Fresh pies just out of the oven, plenty for everyone!
clips.spoken: Welcome, welcome! Fresh pies just out of the oven, plenty for everyone!

clips.text: More people are coming back. Let's host a long-table feast—everyone, those who left and those who stayed, sit down and share a meal.
clips.spoken: More people are coming back. Let's host a long-table feast—everyone, those who left and those who stayed, sit down and share a meal.

clips.text: Feast cakes, spiced mulled wine, warm cloaks—this table must be filled with ten years of longing.
clips.spoken: Feast cakes, spiced mulled wine, warm cloaks—this table must be filled with ten years of longing.

clips.text: A long wooden table stretched from the pier to the end of the street. Strangers sat side-by-side as hot dishes passed along like a flowing river of warmth.
clips.spoken: A long wooden table stretched from the pier to the end of the street. Strangers sat side-by-side as hot dishes passed along like a flowing river of warmth.

clips.text: My sister... she hasn't come back yet. But I dare to wait now. Look, so many people have returned.
clips.spoken: My sister... she hasn't come back yet. But I dare to wait now. Look, so many people have returned.

clips.text: {{playerName}}, you've secured the second kind of warmth for the valley—when people care for one another, that bond never fades.
clips.spoken: You've secured the second kind of warmth for the valley—when people care for one another, that bond never fades.

clips.text: But Choco always felt that the chill of the Frostheart atop the peak hid a story no one wanted to mention.
clips.spoken: But Choco always felt that the chill of the Frostheart atop the peak hid a story no one wanted to mention.

clips.text: ...There's no hiding from what comes next. Tomorrow, I'll take you into Frostwood and show you the truth of ten years ago.
clips.spoken: ...There's no hiding from what comes next. Tomorrow, I'll take you into Frostwood and show you the truth of ten years ago.

clips.text: Behind Homewing Harbor lies Frostwood, shrouded in mist all year. Deep among the trees stands an old waystation used by generations of Frostweavers.
clips.spoken: Behind Homewing Harbor lies Frostwood, shrouded in mist all year. Deep among the trees stands an old waystation used by generations of Frostweavers.

clips.text: Barr's decade-long silence, his grandfather's final footprints—all are buried in this quiet snow. Some ice must first be melted in the heart.
clips.spoken: Barr's decade-long silence, his grandfather's final footprints—all are buried in this quiet snow. Some ice must first be melted in the heart.

clips.text: Follow this snowy path inward; the first outpost was built by you and your grandfather in your youth. Let's clear it out before we head into the mountains tonight.
clips.spoken: Follow this snowy path inward; the first outpost was built by you and your grandfather in your youth. Let's clear it out before we head into the mountains tonight.

clips.text: Put on your down coat. The wind in the woods has a bite to it.
clips.spoken: Put on your down coat. The wind in the woods has a bite to it.

clips.text: Furniture was rearranged and a bonfire rose in the center of the outpost, casting a small square of orange light into the snowy night.
clips.spoken: Furniture was rearranged and a bonfire rose in the center of the outpost, casting a small square of orange light into the snowy night.

clips.text: It was just like this fire years ago. Evan, myself, and a few from the Flame Guard were here, deciding who would head up the mountain.
clips.spoken: It was just like this fire years ago. Evan, myself, and a few from the Flame Guard were here, deciding who would head up the mountain.

clips.text: The Flame Guard? No one ever mentioned them to me.
clips.spoken: The Flame Guard? No one ever mentioned them to me.

clips.text: Because we... failed to keep it. Go further in to the Archive; see for yourself.
clips.spoken: Because we... failed to keep it. Go further in to the Archive; see for yourself.

clips.text: The archive door is sealed by permafrost. Ordinary fire won't melt it; you need a pure Perma-Drill to sync with its frequency.
clips.spoken: The archive door is sealed by permafrost. Ordinary fire won't melt it; you need a pure Perma-Drill to sync with its frequency.

clips.text: Inside lies the record of what happened on that final night of the Flame Guard.
clips.spoken: Inside lies the record of what happened on that final night of the Flame Guard.

clips.text: As the Perma-Drill touched the ice door, the frost glowed and receded like a ebbing tide, revealing walls lined with frostweaver journals.
clips.spoken: As the Perma-Drill touched the ice door, the frost glowed and receded like a ebbing tide, revealing walls lined with frostweaver journals.

clips.text: It's my grandfather's handwriting... 'The Frostheart beats upon the warmth of the mortal world. If the heat fails, it falls into slumber, and the eternal snow follows.'
clips.spoken: It's my grandfather's handwriting... 'The Frostheart beats upon the warmth of the mortal world. If the heat fails, it falls into slumber, and the eternal snow follows.'

clips.text: 'That night, the blizzard was too great; the Flame Guard was trapped halfway up. I couldn't let everyone die with me—it was I who ordered them down.'
clips.spoken: 'That night, the blizzard was too great; the Flame Guard was trapped halfway up. I couldn't let everyone die with me—it was I who ordered them down.'

clips.text: ...He pushed us back to the outpost one by one and climbed alone. We survived, but we blamed ourselves for ten years.
clips.spoken: ...He pushed us back to the outpost one by one and climbed alone. We survived, but we blamed ourselves for ten years.

clips.text: This is our old camp. My daughter gave me this music box; it fell here in the chaos... I didn't dare look for it for ten years.
clips.spoken: This is our old camp. My daughter gave me this music box; it fell here in the chaos... I didn't dare look for it for ten years.

clips.text: Light the hearth, set the furniture, and bring that unfinished Cloud-Weave Cloak—some knots can only be untied where they were tied.
clips.spoken: Light the hearth, set the furniture, and bring that unfinished Cloud-Weave Cloak—some knots can only be untied where they were tied.

clips.text: The hearth flared again. The music box was gently lifted from the snow; as it was wound, its tinkling melody drifted through the woods.
clips.spoken: The hearth flared again. The music box was gently lifted from the snow; as it was wound, its tinkling melody drifted through the woods.

clips.text: That's the tune... I always thought I had abandoned him, and abandoned my promise to my daughter.
clips.spoken: That's the tune... I always thought I had abandoned him, and abandoned my promise to my daughter.

clips.text: Old friend, Evan chose to go up. He pushed you back so you could live—to watch the valley wake up for him.
clips.spoken: Old friend, Evan chose to go up. He pushed you back so you could live—to watch the valley wake up for him.

clips.text: ...Ten years. I can finally let this weight go.
clips.spoken: ...Ten years. I can finally let this weight go.

clips.text: Under the trees ahead... there's an old satchel. It belongs to my grandfather. Let's protect it with Frost Crystals and open it slowly.
clips.spoken: Under the trees ahead... there's an old satchel. It belongs to my grandfather. Let's protect it with Frost Crystals and open it slowly.

clips.text: I don't know why, but as we got closer, the light in my lantern began to pulse more wildly.
clips.spoken: I don't know why, but as we got closer, the light in my lantern began to pulse more wildly.

clips.text: Inside was a journal, half a piece of ginger bread, and a letter addressed to 'the one who carries the lamp.'
clips.spoken: Inside was a journal, half a piece of ginger bread, and a letter addressed to 'the one who carries the lamp.'

clips.text: 'Child, by the time you read this, I will likely be with the Frostheart.'
clips.spoken: 'Child, by the time you read this, I will likely be with the Frostheart.'

clips.text: 'I sealed the last bit of warmth into a wind lantern, turning it into a frost spirit named Choco to accompany you until today.'
clips.spoken: 'I sealed the last bit of warmth into a wind lantern, turning it into a frost spirit named Choco to accompany you until today.'

clips.text: ...So, I am the warmth my grandfather left for you. I'm not just an ordinary frost spirit; I am his unfinished 'Don't be afraid.'
clips.spoken: ...So, I am the warmth my grandfather left for you. I'm not just an ordinary frost spirit; I am his unfinished 'Don't be afraid.'

clips.text: 'The third warmth is release; the fourth is passing this lantern to another. See you at the peak, my child.'
clips.spoken: 'The third warmth is release; the fourth is passing this lantern to another. See you at the peak, my child.'

clips.text: Beyond Frostwood, the source of the Long Snow looms overhead—the summit of Frostheart Mountain, where the storm never rests.
clips.spoken: Beyond Frostwood, the source of the Long Snow looms overhead—the summit of Frostheart Mountain, where the storm never rests.

clips.text: Three of the four mortal warmths are gathered. For the final stretch, carry everyone's warmth and deliver this lantern to the Frostheart.
clips.spoken: Three of the four mortal warmths are gathered. For the final stretch, carry everyone's warmth and deliver this lantern to the Frostheart.

clips.text: We couldn't finish these last icy steps ten years ago. This time, the whole village stands behind you to hold back the wind.
clips.spoken: We couldn't finish these last icy steps ten years ago. This time, the whole village stands behind you to hold back the wind.

clips.text: Frost-wood beams, Frost-crystal paths, and a constant hearth—{{playerName}}, move forward, don't look back.
clips.spoken: Frost-wood beams, Frost-crystal paths, and a constant hearth—move forward, don't look back.

clips.text: Frost-wood was driven into the ice cliffs, Frost-crystals formed chains of light in the snow, and the hearth blocked the biting wind.
clips.spoken: Frost-wood was driven into the ice cliffs, Frost-crystals formed chains of light in the snow, and the hearth blocked the biting wind.

clips.text: All the lights below are lit to guide your way!
clips.spoken: All the lights below are lit to guide your way!

clips.text: I can hear the Frostheart's heartbeat now. It's slow and faint, as if it's waiting for someone.
clips.spoken: I can hear the Frostheart's heartbeat now. It's slow and faint, as if it's waiting for someone.

clips.text: There are four empty urns before the Frostheart, matching the four types of warmth. Offer the hearth, the special brew, the cloak, and the feast cake one by one.
clips.spoken: There are four empty urns before the Frostheart, matching the four types of warmth. Offer the hearth, the special brew, the cloak, and the feast cake one by one.

clips.text: I made a huge feast cake; we'll share it so there's enough sweetness for everyone.
clips.spoken: I made a huge feast cake; we'll share it so there's enough sweetness for everyone.

clips.text: The Cloud-Weave Cloak... let's drape it over the peak as well.
clips.spoken: The Cloud-Weave Cloak... let's drape it over the peak as well.

clips.text: Four warm urns lit up in turn: the fire of hope, the drink of connection, the garment of protection, and the food of gathering.
clips.spoken: Four warm urns lit up in turn: the fire of hope, the drink of connection, the garment of protection, and the food of gathering.

clips.text: Hope's flame, neighborly bonds, the courage of release—all are gathered.
clips.spoken: Hope's flame, neighborly bonds, the courage of release—all are gathered.

clips.text: Only one thing remains: the wish to pass the light. That must be done by me, personally.
clips.spoken: Only one thing remains: the wish to pass the light. That must be done by me, personally.

clips.text: The Frostheart is just behind the door. Use the Perma-Drill as a key, the Frost-wood as a guide, and tie the down coat to the door—the wind beyond will be very, very cold.
clips.spoken: The Frostheart is just behind the door. Use the Perma-Drill as a key, the Frost-wood as a guide, and tie the down coat to the door—the wind beyond will be very, very cold.

clips.text: Don't be afraid. Once the door opens, you'll see why frostweavers have guarded this valley for generations.
clips.spoken: Don't be afraid. Once the door opens, you'll see why frostweavers have guarded this valley for generations.

clips.text: The Ice Gate opened silently. In the eye of the storm, there was no wind—only a massive blue heart beating slowly, and an old man made of light standing before it.
clips.spoken: The Ice Gate opened silently. In the eye of the storm, there was no wind—only a massive blue heart beating slowly, and an old man made of light standing before it.

clips.text: You've come, {{playerName}}. It was a long road; you've worked hard, my child.
clips.spoken: You've come. It was a long road; you've worked hard, my child.

clips.text: Grandfather...
clips.spoken: Grandfather...

clips.text: I merged myself into the Frostheart to keep it beating for ten years, just so you could arrive here with the four temperatures. Now, let this heart beat on its own for the whole valley.
clips.spoken: I merged myself into the Frostheart to keep it beating for ten years, just so you could arrive here with the four temperatures. Now, let this heart beat on its own for the whole valley.

clips.text: The Everwarm Flame is hope, the Everfrost Drill is memory, the Sunny Special is longing, and the Feast Cake is reunion—{{playerName}}, place these four into the Frostheart.
clips.spoken: The Everwarm Flame is hope, the Everfrost Drill is memory, the Sunny Special is longing, and the Feast Cake is reunion—place these four into the Frostheart.

clips.text: And me. I am also the last bit of warmth my grandfather left for the valley.
clips.spoken: And me. I am also the last bit of warmth my grandfather left for the valley.

clips.text: Don't be sad for me; I won't disappear. I will become the spring breeze, the hearth fire, and that tiny spark of warmth felt whenever someone thinks of another.
clips.spoken: Don't be sad for me; I won't disappear. I will become the spring breeze, the hearth fire, and that tiny spark of warmth felt whenever someone thinks of another.

clips.text: As the four temperatures merged into the Frostheart, Choco turned into a beam of gentle light, embracing the massive heart.
clips.spoken: As the four temperatures merged into the Frostheart, Choco turned into a beam of gentle light, embracing the massive heart.

clips.text: The lantern is in your hands now. The spring of Frostwhisper Valley is in your hands; keep it safe for generations to come.
clips.spoken: The lantern is in your hands now. The spring of Frostwhisper Valley is in your hands; keep it safe for generations to come.

clips.text: The Frostheart flared brilliantly, a wave of blue light surging down the ridge—wherever it touched, snow melted, grass turned green, and the river, frozen for ten years, began to sing once more.
clips.spoken: The Frostheart flared brilliantly, a wave of blue light surging down the ridge—wherever it touched, snow melted, grass turned green, and the river, frozen for ten years, began to sing once more.

clips.text: Look, the snow has stopped. This time, it's really stopped.
clips.spoken: Look, the snow has stopped. This time, it's really stopped.

clips.text: The wind... smells like blooming flowers.
clips.spoken: The wind... smells like blooming flowers.

clips.text: The fleet of ships heading home stretches as far as the eye can see!
clips.spoken: The fleet of ships heading home stretches as far as the eye can see!

clips.text: — Frostwhisper Valley: Seasons Restored, Warmth Everlasting —
clips.spoken: — Frostwhisper Valley: Seasons Restored, Warmth Everlasting —

clips.text: From then on, spring never left Frostwhisper Valley again.
clips.spoken: From then on, spring never left Frostwhisper Valley again.

clips.text: Gunnar took up his hunting bow once more as a forest guardian, telling tales of the Flame Guard to every child who entered the woods.
clips.spoken: Gunnar took up his hunting bow once more as a forest guardian, telling tales of the Flame Guard to every child who entered the woods.

clips.text: Mier finally welcomed her sister home; from then on, two teacups sat by the window.
clips.spoken: Mier finally welcomed her sister home; from then on, two teacups sat by the window.

clips.text: Bobo became the busiest courier in Homewing Harbor. Not a single undelivered letter remained in his mailbag.
clips.spoken: Bobo became the busiest courier in Homewing Harbor. Not a single undelivered letter remained in his mailbag.

clips.text: Grandma Elsa opened a weaving shop, weaving the tradition of 'a scarf for everyone' into every day in the valley.
clips.spoken: Grandma Elsa opened a weaving shop, weaving the tradition of 'a scarf for everyone' into every day in the valley.

clips.text: Barr restored the Warm Current and cast the music box's melody into the sanctuary's new bell. Whenever the wind blows, the whole valley can hear it.
clips.spoken: Barr restored the Warm Current and cast the music box's melody into the sanctuary's new bell. Whenever the wind blows, the whole valley can hear it.

clips.text: Evan's name was carved onto the Gate of Frostheart, alongside those of every frostweaver before him.
clips.spoken: Evan's name was carved onto the Gate of Frostheart, alongside those of every frostweaver before him.

clips.text: As for me—whenever you merge a warm item, hand out a hot drink, or leave a light on for someone, listen closely. I'm right there in that soft, warm heartbeat.
clips.spoken: As for me—whenever you merge a warm item, hand out a hot drink, or leave a light on for someone, listen closely. I'm right there in that soft, warm heartbeat.

clips.text: Frost Story · Thank you, {{playerName}}, for merging spring back together, one piece at a time.
clips.spoken: Frost Story. Thank you for merging spring back together, one piece at a time.

clips.text: The door curtain was whipped open by the wind. The snow on Gunnar's shoulders hadn't melted yet, and he clutched a frozen, cracked fire-whistle wick in his hand.
clips.spoken: The door curtain was whipped open by the wind. The snow on Gunnar's shoulders hadn't melted yet, and he clutched a frozen, cracked fire-whistle wick in his hand.

clips.text: The wind and snow have doused the patrol beacons again. I need to relight the markers before dark. Could you gather these supplies for me?
clips.spoken: The wind and snow have doused the patrol beacons again. I need to relight the markers before dark. Could you gather these supplies for me?

clips.text: When the beacon glows, everyone traveling at night knows home is just ahead.
clips.spoken: When the beacon glows, everyone traveling at night knows home is just ahead.

clips.text: A faint scent of wheat drifted into the room as Mier held a freshly wiped baking tray, carefully stepping around the snow at the door.
clips.spoken: A faint scent of wheat drifted into the room as Mier held a freshly wiped baking tray, carefully stepping around the snow at the door.

clips.text: The bakery's hearth has just woken up, but the racks are still empty. Help me gather these supplies, and I'll share the first batch of bread with everyone in the square.
clips.spoken: The bakery's hearth has just woken up, but the racks are still empty. Help me gather these supplies, and I'll share the first batch of bread with everyone in the square.

clips.text: Can you smell it? This is the first scent of wheat from Frostwhisper Valley since the ovens were relit.
clips.spoken: Can you smell it? This is the first scent of wheat from Frostwhisper Valley since the ovens were relit.

clips.text: A frantic jingle of bells came from outside. Bobo pulled a crooked sled toward him, several frost-covered letters peeking out of his mailbag.
clips.spoken: A frantic jingle of bells came from outside. Bobo pulled a crooked sled toward him, several frost-covered letters peeking out of his mailbag.

clips.text: There's a pile of undelivered mail at the port. With these supplies, I can fix my bag and sled.
clips.spoken: There's a pile of undelivered mail at the port. With these supplies, I can fix my bag and sled.

clips.text: The letters will get through. Those waiting for news shouldn't have to wait another winter.
clips.spoken: The letters will get through. Those waiting for news shouldn't have to wait another winter.

clips.text: Grandma Elsa placed a stack of old winter clothes on the table; the corners still bore crooked little suns drawn by children.
clips.spoken: Grandma Elsa placed a stack of old winter clothes on the table; the corners still bore crooked little suns drawn by children.

clips.text: These old coats can no longer block the wind. I want to patch them before tonight, but I'm missing these materials.
clips.spoken: These old coats can no longer block the wind. I want to patch them before tonight, but I'm missing these materials.

clips.text: The stitches hold more than just against the wind; they hold the hearts of those who choose to stay.
clips.spoken: The stitches hold more than just against the wind; they hold the hearts of those who choose to stay.

clips.text: A heavy toolbox hit the floor. Barr spread out a bridge bolt snapped in two, its edge coated in a layer of white frost.
clips.spoken: A heavy toolbox hit the floor. Barr spread out a bridge bolt snapped in two, its edge coated in a layer of white frost.

clips.text: The bolts and brackets are frozen brittle. I need these materials to forge them anew before the next wind cuts the path again.
clips.spoken: The bolts and brackets are frozen brittle. I need these materials to forge them anew before the next wind cuts the path again.

clips.text: When the iron glows red and the forge roars, the village stays whole.
clips.spoken: When the iron glows red and the forge roars, the village stays whole.

clips.text: The wind lantern is warming up... Touch that blue light.
clips.spoken: The wind lantern is warming up... Touch that blue light.

clips.text: These two frost crystals are resonating. Try bringing them together?
clips.spoken: These two frost crystals are resonating. Try bringing them together?

clips.text: Shh—someone's coming through the snow. Let's listen to why they're knocking.
clips.spoken: Shh—someone's coming through the snow. Let's listen to why they're knocking.

clips.text: Gunnar entrusted us with the fire whistle. Give him the finished frost crystal.
clips.spoken: Gunnar entrusted us with the fire whistle. Give him the finished frost crystal.

clips.text: The fire whistle reveals a loose piece of ice. Tap that snow lock.
clips.spoken: The fire whistle reveals a loose piece of ice. Tap that snow lock.

clips.text: Mier said the market is reopening. Let's see what's glowing inside.
clips.spoken: Mier said the market is reopening. Let's see what's glowing inside.

clips.text: A faint spark sounds from beneath the plaza. Go to the valley; it's waiting for us.
clips.spoken: A faint spark sounds from beneath the plaza. Go to the valley; it's waiting for us.

clips.text: It's awake... your grandfather's mine still recognizes you.
clips.spoken: It's awake... your grandfather's mine still recognizes you.

clips.text: Do you hear that? There's a spark in the sound of cracking ice.
clips.spoken: Do you hear that? There's a spark in the sound of cracking ice.

clips.text: Gunnar didn't leave. He's been guarding the night roads for this empty village.
clips.spoken: Gunnar didn't leave. He's been guarding the night roads for this empty village.

clips.text: The first fire whistle lit up in the distance.
clips.spoken: The first fire whistle lit up in the distance.

clips.text: Beneath the ice lies a path left behind ten years ago.
clips.spoken: Beneath the ice lies a path left behind ten years ago.

clips.text: The shelves are empty, but the bell still rings. This place will be lively again.
clips.spoken: The shelves are empty, but the bell still rings. This place will be lively again.

clips.text: {{npcName}} entrusted this to us. Check the materials already on the board first.
clips.spoken: This was entrusted to us. Check the materials on the board first.

clips.text: See? We're giving more than just materials. The village has one more story for people to remember.
clips.spoken: See? We're giving more than just materials. The village has one more story for people to remember.

clips.text: The valley is blooming with spring now, but we can keep merging and gathering to make life even warmer.
clips.spoken: The valley is blooming with spring now, but we can keep merging and gathering to make life even warmer.

clips.text: All materials for "{{nodeName}}" are ready! Open the Valley Delivery to continue the story.
clips.spoken: All materials are ready! Open the Valley Delivery to continue the story.

clips.text: "{{nodeName}}" is missing {{itemName}}. Tap the red items in the quest to find the {{generatorName}} and full merge chain.
clips.spoken: One more material needed. Tap the red items in the quest to find the Supply Station and full merge chain.

clips.text: This part of the story awaits Lv. {{level}}. Just complete a few more commissions.
clips.spoken: This part of the story requires a few more levels. Just complete a few more commissions.

clips.text: Just follow the main quest. Next stop: "{{nodeName}}".
clips.spoken: Just follow the main quest. The next stop is just ahead.

clips.text: The {{generatorName}} is here. Tap it to produce {{baseItem}}. Merge pairs of identical items to progress along the chain.
clips.spoken: The Supply Station is here. Tap it for base materials. Merge pairs of identical items to progress along the chain.

clips.text: Drag these two {{currentItem}} together first. Each merge brings you closer to {{targetItem}}. Tap red items to light up the next pair.
clips.spoken: Drag the two lit materials together. Each merge brings you closer to the goal. Tap red items to light up the next pair.

clips.text: 北の果てに、雪に埋もれた谷がある。名は、霜語りの谷。
clips.spoken: 北の果てに、雪に埋もれた谷がある。名は、霜語りの谷。

clips.text: 10年前、谷の中心にある「永暖の聖火」が突如消え、それ以来、吹雪が止むことはなかった。
clips.spoken: 10年前、谷の中心にある永暖の聖火が突如消え、それ以来、吹雪が止むことはなかった。

clips.text: 私はチョコ。あなたのおじいちゃんの風灯に住む、最後の霜の精だよ。
clips.spoken: 私はチョコ。あなたのおじいちゃんの風灯に住む、最後の霜の精だよ。

clips.text: おじいちゃんは言ってた——雪は、誰かが最初にかかなきゃって。今度はあなたが、この風灯を持って帰る番だよ。
clips.spoken: おじいちゃんは言ってた——雪は、誰かが最初にかかなきゃって。今度はあなたが、この風灯を持って帰る番だよ。

clips.text: 待って……風灯はあなたの手を覚えてる。でも私は、まだなんて呼べばいいか知らないんだ。
clips.spoken: 待って……風灯はあなたの手を覚えてる。でも私は、まだなんて呼べばいいか知らないんだ。

clips.text: 教えて。谷じゅうの灯りがともったら、帰ってくるみんなに、その名前を伝えたいの。
clips.spoken: 教えて。谷じゅうの灯りがともったら、帰ってくるみんなに、その名前を伝えたいの。

clips.text: {{playerName}}……うん、覚えた。行こう。一緒に春を取り戻すんだ。
clips.spoken: うん、覚えた。行こう。一緒に春を取り戻すんだ。

clips.text: 吹雪は十年ものあいだ止まず、霜語りの谷の焚き火は一つ、また一つと消えていった。
clips.spoken: 吹雪は十年ものあいだ止まず、霜語りの谷の焚き火は一つ、また一つと消えていった。

clips.text: 祖父が遺した風灯を手に、私は村へ帰った。雪は深い。それでも腰をかがめてかき始めれば、最初の一本道はきっと作れる。
clips.spoken: 祖父が遺した風灯を手に、私は村へ帰った。雪は深い。それでも腰をかがめてかき始めれば、最初の一本道はきっと作れる。

clips.text: 広場の焚き火の下に、まだ凍りきっていない火の粉が隠れているみたい！
clips.spoken: 広場の焚き火の下に、まだ凍りきっていない火の粉が隠れているみたい！

clips.text: お前さん、よく燃える「大きな焚き火」を合成して、ゴールドで火を呼び戻してくれ。この村は、ここから目を覚ます。
clips.spoken: お前さん、よく燃える大きな焚き火を合成して、ゴールドで火を呼び戻してくれ。この村は、ここから目を覚ます。

clips.text: まだ火の粉があるわ！風にさらわれる前に……もう少しだけ近づいて。
clips.spoken: まだ火の粉があるわ！風にさらわれる前に……もう少しだけ近づいて。

clips.text: 十年ぶりか……やっと指先に感覚が戻った。わしはグンナー。この村を離れなかった、最後の老猟師だ。
clips.spoken: 十年ぶりか……やっと指先に感覚が戻った。わしはグンナー。この村を離れなかった、最後の老猟師だ。

clips.text: {{playerName}}、君が持っているその風灯はエヴァンのものだろう。彼は君の祖父であり、この谷で最高の霜術師だった。
clips.spoken: 君が持っているその風灯はエヴァンのものだろう。彼は君の祖父であり、この谷で最高の霜術師だった。

clips.text: 聞いて。誰かが窓を開けたよ。最初の火は飾りじゃない——私たちが帰ってきたと、みんなが信じられた証なんだ。
clips.spoken: 聞いて。誰かが窓を開けたよ。最初の火は飾りじゃない——私たちが帰ってきたと、みんなが信じられた証なんだ。

clips.text: この屋根から雪が漏れ続けて3年だ。夜には布団に雪が積もり、朝には雪の山から自分を掘り出さなきゃならなかった。
clips.spoken: この屋根から雪が漏れ続けて3年だ。夜には布団に雪が積もり、朝には雪の山から自分を掘り出さなきゃならなかった。

clips.text: 丈夫な板を二枚合わせて、釘を打つ代金も少し頼む。この老いぼれに、雪の落ちてこない夜を眠らせてくれ。
clips.spoken: 丈夫な板を二枚合わせて、釘を打つ代金も少し頼む。この老いぼれに、雪の落ちてこない夜を眠らせてくれ。

clips.text: 板を打ち込めば風雪は門の外に遮られ、家の中は炭の爆ぜる音だけが響くほど静かになる。
clips.spoken: 板を打ち込めば風雪は門の外に遮られ、家の中は炭の爆ぜる音だけが響くほど静かになる。

clips.text: グンナーおじいちゃん、さっき私のおじいちゃんのことを……十年前、どこへ行ったの？
clips.spoken: グンナーおじいちゃん、さっき私のおじいちゃんのことを……十年前、どこへ行ったの？

clips.text: エヴァンは……最後に山頂へ向かった。この村をもう少し温かくしたら、ゆっくり話してやろう。
clips.spoken: エヴァンは……最後に山頂へ向かった。この村をもう少し温かくしたら、ゆっくり話してやろう。

clips.text: わかった。まずは、どの家にも雪が入らないようにするよ。
clips.spoken: わかった。まずは、どの家にも雪が入らないようにするよ。

clips.text: あ、あの——橋の向こうに誰かいる？ ぼくは郵便屋のボボ！ 十年も届けられなかった手紙を、袋いっぱい背負ってきたんだ！
clips.spoken: あ、あの——橋の向こうに誰かいる？ ぼくは郵便屋のボボ！ 十年も届けられなかった手紙を、袋いっぱい背負ってきたんだ！

clips.text: でも橋が壊れて、氷の上は怖くて渡れないんだ。木の梁を架けて、たいまつで道を照らしてくれない？ みんな外からの便りを待ってるよ。
clips.spoken: でも橋が壊れて、氷の上は怖くて渡れないんだ。木の梁を架けて、たいまつで道を照らしてくれない？ みんな外からの便りを待ってるよ。

clips.text: て、手紙を村まで運べる！ 見て、この一通——山の向こうから、「霜語りの谷に残った人たちへ」だって！
clips.spoken: て、手紙を村まで運べる！ 見て、この一通——山の向こうから、霜語りの谷に残った人たちへだって！

clips.text: 外の世界は、まだわしらを忘れていなかったんだな。
clips.spoken: 外の世界は、まだわしらを忘れていなかったんだな。

clips.text: 橋がつながったから、みんなも少しずつ帰ってくるはず。エルサおばあちゃんが毛糸かごを預けてくれたよ。まずは旅人に温かい手袋を編もう。
clips.spoken: 橋がつながったから、みんなも少しずつ帰ってくるはず。エルサおばあちゃんが毛糸かごを預けてくれたよ。まずは旅人に温かい手袋を編もう。

clips.text: やったあ！ この手紙、谷のすみずみまで届けてくるね！
clips.spoken: やったあ！ この手紙、谷のすみずみまで届けてくるね！

clips.text: 今夜はみんなを集会所に呼ぼう。十年ものあいだ、夜に集まる者はいなかった——次に会うとき、また誰かが消えているのが怖かったからな。
clips.spoken: 今夜はみんなを集会所に呼ぼう。十年ものあいだ、夜に集まる者はいなかった——次に会うとき、また誰かが消えているのが怖かったからな。

clips.text: それなら手袋を編んで、熱いお茶をたっぷり淹れよう。今夜をぽかぽかにして、みんなに残る勇気を取り戻してもらうんだ。
clips.spoken: それなら手袋を編んで、熱いお茶をたっぷり淹れよう。今夜をぽかぽかにして、みんなに残る勇気を取り戻してもらうんだ。

clips.text: あなたは「{{choice}}」を梁に掛けた。炉の火はパチパチと跳ね、熱いお茶から湯気が立ち上る。村の広間には初めて笑い声が響いた。
clips.spoken: 選んだメインランタンを梁に掛けた。炉の火がぱちぱちとはぜ、熱いお茶から白い湯気が立つ。集会所には、初めて笑い声が響いた。

clips.text: エヴァンが去った夜も、同じような火があった。彼は言っていた。聖火は風で消えたのではない。人が少しずつ忘れ、薪をくべなくなって冷えていったのだと。
clips.spoken: エヴァンが去った夜も、同じような火があった。彼は言っていた。聖火は風で消えたのではない。人が少しずつ忘れ、薪をくべなくなって冷えていったのだと。

clips.text: 山へ行く前にこの風灯を私に預け、「次に雪を掃く者が戻ってきたら、代わりに返してくれ」と言ったんだ。
clips.spoken: 山へ行く前にこの風灯を私に預け、次に雪を掃く者が戻ってきたら、代わりに返してくれと言ったんだ。

clips.text: 私が残されたのは、あなたを待つためだったんだね、{{playerName}}。
clips.spoken: 私が残されたのは、あなたを待つためだったんだね。

clips.text: 村は目を覚ました。でも、私たちだけじゃ足りない——木橋の向こうでは、通りが丸ごと雪の下で眠ってる。
clips.spoken: 村は目を覚ました。でも、私たちだけじゃ足りない——木橋の向こうでは、通りが丸ごと雪の下で眠ってる。

clips.text: パン屋の古いオーブンを持ってきました。次の灯りがともる時、香りも一緒に橋を渡れるようにしましょう。
clips.spoken: パン屋の古いオーブンを持ってきました。次の灯りがともる時、香りも一緒に橋を渡れるようにしましょう。

clips.text: 木橋の向こう側では、パン屋や仕立て屋、古い桟橋までもが雪に埋もれ、看板は重みで顔を上げられない様子でした。
clips.spoken: 木橋の向こう側では、パン屋や仕立て屋、古い桟橋までもが雪に埋もれ、看板は重みで顔を上げられない様子でした。

clips.text: すべての店に火を灯し、この通りに再び熱気と香りを呼び戻しましょう。
clips.spoken: すべての店に火を灯し、この通りに再び熱気と香りを呼び戻しましょう。

clips.text: あら、人の足音がするわ！私はミエル、パン職人よ。オーブンが凍りついて開かないの。レシピも氷の塊になっちゃって……。
clips.spoken: あら、人の足音がするわ！私はミエル、パン職人よ。オーブンが凍りついて開かないの。レシピも氷の塊になっちゃって……。

clips.text: 焼き麦パンと熱いお茶を用意して、まずオーブンを温めてくれる？ 香りが立てば、みんなに『ここにはまだ帰る家がある』って伝わるわ。
clips.spoken: 焼き麦パンと熱いお茶を用意して、まずオーブンを温めてくれる？ 香りが立てば、みんなにここにはまだ帰る家があるって伝わるわ。

clips.text: オーブンが温まれば、焼き麦パンの香りは山の麓まで届くわ！ ほら、香ってみて——最初のひと焼きは始まりよ。ベリーパイも、もうすぐ帰ってくる。
clips.spoken: オーブンが温まれば、焼き麦パンの香りは山の麓まで届くわ！ ほら、香ってみて——最初のひと焼きは始まりよ。ベリーパイも、もうすぐ帰ってくる。

clips.text: これが、谷が目を覚ます香りなんだね。ミエルお姉ちゃん、災厄の年にどうして出ていかなかったの？
clips.spoken: これが、谷が目を覚ます香りなんだね。ミエルお姉ちゃん、災厄の年にどうして出ていかなかったの？

clips.text: 妹と約束したの。店を守って、帰ってきたら私が焼く最初のパイを食べてもらうって。
clips.spoken: 妹と約束したの。店を守って、帰ってきたら私が焼く最初のパイを食べてもらうって。

clips.text: 最初のパイは、あなたにあげるわ、{{playerName}}。ありがとう。また誰かを待つ勇気をくれて。
clips.spoken: 最初のパイは、あなたにあげるわ。ありがとう。また誰かを待つ勇気をくれて。

clips.text: あらまあ、老眼鏡までテーブルに凍りついてしまったわ。さあ、おいで。おばあちゃんと一緒にニット帽を編んで、マフラーも用意しましょう。
clips.spoken: あらまあ、老眼鏡までテーブルに凍りついてしまったわ。さあ、おいで。おばあちゃんと一緒にニット帽を編んで、マフラーも用意しましょう。

clips.text: ふわふわで柔らかく編むのよ。マフラーは一人ひとつずつね。この谷では、もう誰も凍らせてはいけないわ。
clips.spoken: ふわふわで柔らかく編むのよ。マフラーは一人ひとつずつね。この谷では、もう誰も凍らせてはいけないわ。

clips.text: 帽子はふんわり柔らかく。マフラーは一人に一本。この谷では、もう誰も寒さに震えさせないよ。
clips.spoken: 帽子はふんわり柔らかく。マフラーは一人に一本。この谷では、もう誰も寒さに震えさせないよ。

clips.text: エルサおばあちゃんの編み物は、かまどの火よりも温かいね。

clips.text: バルが10年間沈黙した過去、祖父の最後の足跡。それらはすべてこの静かな雪の中に埋もれています。いくつかの氷は、まず心の中で溶かす必要があります。

clips.spoken: 永久凍土のドリルを氷の門に押し当てると、氷の層が引き潮のように輝きながら広がり、壁一面の霜術師の手記が現れました。

clips.text: これは祖父の文字……。『霜の心臓は人の温もりに反応して鼓動する。温もりが途絶えれば眠りにつき、長雪が立ち塞がる』。

clips.text: 『あの日、吹雪があまりに激しく、守護隊は山の中腹で孤立した。全員を共倒れにさせるわけにはいかない――私の方から、彼らに下りるよう命じたのだ』。
clips.spoken: あの日、吹雪があまりに激しく、守護隊は山の中腹で孤立した。全員を共倒れにさせるわけにはいかない――私の方から、彼らに下りるよう命じたのだ。

clips.text: ……彼は我々を一人ずつ宿へと押し戻し、自分だけが山へ登った。我々は生き残ったが、10年間自分たちを責め続けてきた。
clips.spoken: ……彼は我々を一人ずつ宿へと押し戻し、自分だけが山へ登った。我々は生き残ったが、10年間自分たちを責め続けてきた。

clips.text: これは当時撤退した際のキャンプだ。娘がくれたオルゴールを、混乱の中でここに落とした……10年も探し続けながら、手を出せなかった。
clips.spoken: これは当時撤退した際のキャンプだ。娘がくれたオルゴールを、混乱の中でここに落とした……10年も探し続けながら、手を出せなかった。

clips.text: 暖炉に火を灯し、家具を並べましょう。そしてあの未完成の織雲の外套も持っていくの。いくつかの結び目は、その場所でしか解けないから。
clips.spoken: 暖炉に火を灯し、家具を並べましょう。そしてあの未完成の織雲の外套も持っていくの。いくつかの結び目は、その場所でしか解けないから。

clips.text: 暖炉が再び燃え上がり、雪の中からオルゴールがそっと取り出されました。ゼンマイを巻くと、チリンと旋律が森の中に響き渡りました。
clips.spoken: 暖炉が再び燃え上がり、雪の中からオルゴールがそっと取り出されました。ゼンマイを巻くと、チリンと旋律が森の中に響き渡りました。

clips.text: このメロディだ……ずっと、彼を見捨てたこと、娘との約束を破ったことを後悔していたんだ。

clips.spoken: 友よ、エヴァンは自ら山へ行くことを選んだ。彼は君を突き返したことで、君に生きてこの谷の目覚めを見届けてほしかったんだ。

clips.text: 前方の木の下に……古い鞄があるわ。祖父のものよ。霜晶で守りながら、ゆっくりと開けましょう。

clips.text: 4つの温かな瓶が次々と輝いた。それは希望の火、繋がる絆、諦念の勇気、そして集う喜び。

clips.text: よく来たな、{{playerName}}。長い道のりだったろう、よく頑張ったぞ、我が子よ。
